text:
maria: Hey team — incoming security questionnaire from Quantasec (SIG/CAIQ style). They want answers for a POC next week and a short risk summary for their procurement. Docs: https://files.example.com/quantasec-sig-2026.pdf. Can someone from security pick this up? They also asked if we can cap POC costs at $5k and support BYOK + EU data residency.

olivia: @dan can you take? I'll create an intake ticket. marking as high priority. :exclamation:

sec-bot: New intake created: SR-4821 — owner: unassigned, priority: high, source: sales. (https://infra.redwood/sr/SR-4821)

dan: assigning to myself — I'll need the filled questionnaire (they sent a PDF) and a list of what the POC infra looks like. Quick Qs: 1) Is customer asking for full BYOK key lifecycle (generation + rotation) or just ability to bring an existing key? 2) Which region for EU residency (eu-west-1 / eu-central-1)?

maria: thanks @dan. They want BYOK where they supply keys (no rotation requirement on our side) and EU residency in eu-central-1. POC scope: low TPS demo, sample production data (deidentified) but still considered regulated. They asked for SLA language for the POC as well.

luis: tagging in case infra hints are helpful — for a low-TPS POC we usually spin a single Dedicated slot with quantized model (q4) and KV caching enabled. If security ok with that, I can draft the POC cost estimate: ~2 GPU hours/day for 7 days -> estimate in comments.

dan: got it. I'll start drafting SIG answers and a short risk note. Preliminary ETA: 3 business days to produce completed SIG + risk summary. If we need redactions for any answers we'll call it out.

maria: customer wants responses earlier if possible — they have procurement meeting Friday. Can security try to expedite? Even a partial answers set would help.

dan: understood. I'll prioritize the high-risk questions first and aim to have a Q&A snapshot by Thursday EOD. Full completed questionnaire by Monday next week if nothing blocks.

olivia: I'll flag SR-4821 in the sales tracker and mark procurement deadline 2026-04-02. Also noting the $5k POC cap.

maria: Also question re: pricing — can we offer trial credits or a temporary promo seat for the POC instead of an invoice? That would speed procurement.

dan: security doesn't sign off on pricing. From a risk perspective the $5k cap is fine. Recommend sales follow current trial/credit policy; if promo needed, loop in finance for an exception.

luis: I can prepare a one-page POC cost and runbook that fits under $5k if we go with the Dedicated single-slot q4 flow + autoscaling off. I'll attach numbers to SR-4821.

olivia: great — @maria pls drop the questionnaire PDF into the ticket and I will ping finance for credit options.

maria: dropped PDF into SR-4821 and added a short cover note with customer contact. Thanks all — please update the ticket when you have drafts, calling out any required deviations (BYOK, region, data handling). :pray:

sec-bot: SR-4821 updated: owner=dan, attachments=quantasec-sig-2026.pdf, priority=high, deadline=2026-04-02.

dan: picking this up now. Will post the first-pass answers as comments in SR-4821 and @maria when ready for review.

olivia: I'll follow up with finance on credits and confirm back in this thread.

maria: perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround.

luis: tagging the sample runbook link here for reuse: https://playbooks.redwood/poc-runbooks/dedicated-single-slot.md

dan: note for tracker: risk checkpoints — KMS BYOK (customer-supplied keys), data residency (eu-central-1), eval data handling (PII flagged). I'll include mitigation suggestions in the risk summary.

maria: thanks, team.
